Algérie Poste (AP) a annoncé une mise à: Algérie Poste (AP) has announced a major update to the interface of its automated teller machines (ATM) and cash dispensers (GAB). Starting today, May 21, 2026, the PIN code will now be verified on the second screen after inserting the card, a technical development aimed at streamlining transactions and enhancing the efficiency of electronic money services in Algeria.
L'entreprise franchit une nouvelle étape: The company is taking a new step in optimizing its electronic banking services with an update to the interface of its ATMs and GABs. Starting today, Algerian users will notice a change in the PIN verification process: it will now be requested on the second screen, after inserting the card, rather than on the first screen as before.
Cette modification, bien que technique,: This modification, although technical, is part of a continuous improvement process for financial services in Algeria. According to SAP, this development is expected to significantly reduce the time needed to complete transactions while strengthening the security and efficiency of electronic money operations.
Un contexte marqué par la digitalisation: A context marked by the digitalization of banking services
En Algérie, où les services de paiement: In Algeria, where electronic payment services are experiencing sustained growth, this update comes within a rapidly changing ecosystem. Telecom operators such as Mobilis, Djezzy, and Ooredoo play a key role in this dynamic by offering mobile payment solutions (such as Djezzy Money, Ooredoo Cash, or Mobilis Pay) that complement the traditional services of banks and AP.
La modernisation des DAB et GAB s’aligne: The modernization of ATMs and GABs thus aligns with the expectations of Algerian consumers, who are increasingly accustomed to fast and intuitive interfaces. This initiative by SAP adds to other recent efforts, such as the expansion of the ATM network or the integration of new features in local banking applications.
Pour les clients d'AP, cette mise à jour: For AP customers, this update translates to a smoother and less restrictive experience. The process of withdrawing cash or checking balances, once perceived as sometimes long or complex, now benefits from an optimized interface. SAP emphasizes that this development is part of its commitment to guaranteeing a faster and more secure user experience while maintaining Algerians' trust in electronic money services.
Cette annonce intervient alors que le ma: This announcement comes as the Algerian telecom and financial services market continues to structure itself, with increased competition between operators and banking players to capture a growing share of digital transactions.
AP n’a pas communiqué de calendrier préc: AP has not communicated a precise schedule for any further updates, but this first step could pave the way for other innovations in the field of ATMs and GABs. In a country where financial inclusion remains a major challenge, initiatives like this contribute to expanding access to banking services for citizens, particularly in rural or underserved areas.
Pour les utilisateurs, il est recommandé: Users are advised to familiarize themselves with this new interface starting today. Algérie Poste has assured that guides and support materials will be made available to facilitate a smooth transition.
La Société Algérienne des Postes remerci: Algérie Poste thanks its customers for their trust and reaffirms its commitment to offering increasingly efficient services tailored to the needs of the Algerian market.
